stories.summary: Clone an existing catalog skill under a new name: create a build and copy the whole skill folder to the new skill path on the fixed build/<skill-name> branch cut from main, reset that fixed branch when a prior build for the same name was abandoned, rewrite only the two name-bearing manifest fields (SKILL.md frontmatter name and verify.yaml top-level skill) so both static manifest checks pass, leave the source skill and main unchanged, and reject a missing source, a new name already on main or a new name used by an open build. The verify.yaml top-level skill rewrite is required in addition to the SKILL.md frontmatter name by python tools/check.py, so FR-013's frontmatter wording is read as covering both name-bearing fields; the corresponding PRD/epic/ADR wording clarification is a recorded cross-document follow-up. Adds the clone mode to BSB-19-PENDING-1's single shared GET /builds/new + POST /builds handler and creates no second handler at that route

Open an existing catalog skill in an edit build on a branch cut from the head of main that reuses the existing skill folder and creates no second one, with head_sha equal to base_sha until BSB-21's first save and the fixed build/<skill-name> branch reset when a prior build for the same skill was merged or abandoned (the merged case is asserted; the abandoned case follows the same rule stated in Notes); adds the edit mode and its inverted existing-on-main predicate to BSB-19-PENDING-1's same shared GET /builds/new + POST /builds handler, reuses BSB-19-PENDING-3's skill-name pattern validator and open-build collision check unchanged rather than parameterising that validator, and rejects a name absent from main, a skill used by an open build or an empty submission
